Identity.History: The Iberians were diverse peoples of eastern and southern Iberia who developed fortified settlements, distinctive art, regional kingdoms, and strong trading ties with Phoenicians, Greeks, and Carthaginians. Renowned as infantry and cavalry, Iberian warriors often served as mercenaries. During the Punic Wars, much of Iberia became a battlefield between Carthage and Rome before Roman conquest gradually absorbed the region over the next two centuries.
